messages:
tara: Heads-up: marketplace launch checklist — need final landing hero, partner logos, SI dry-run slot. Can we lock today?
devin: I'll own hero + subhead. sending draft in 30m. need final CTA text from product.
li: CTA suggestion: 'Get started — 14-day dedicated trial'. OK?
devin: works.
tara: embargo asks for Thu 08:00 PT. partners want morning demo slots the same day. worried about screenshots leaking. suggestions?
maya: recommend watermarking partner screenshots and doing partner demos before 07:30 PT. ops can keep a rollback snapshot.
ops-bot: Ops: staging cut scheduled Tue 19:00 PT tentatively. rollback plan includes db snapshot + traffic toggle, est 10-25m.
legal-bot: Legal: vendor logo use still pending. expect sign-off by Tue 15:00 PT. customer quotes require signed consent before publish.
press-bot: Press: embargo template ready. Need exec quote by Wed 16:00 PT.
li: localization: need final copy by Tue 11:00 PT for fr/de/ja. engineering can turn banners around in 18h.
devin: draft hero: "Production-ready inference, consistent across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments."
tara: can we add a benefit line for predictable latency?
devin: added subhead: "Predictable latency and cost controls for production LLMs."
maya: SI checklist quick:
- tenant provisioned
- anonymized test data loaded
- runbook validated
- demo scripts updated
- watermark applied
- HW smoke test (power/thermal)

ops-bot: I'll add uptime probe and telemetry check on landing route pre-release.
tara: recap: devin hero + CTA by 11:30 PT, li localization + consents, maya SI dry-run owner, ops runbook + probes, legal final signoff Tue 15:00 PT, press waiting for exec quote. soft staging Tue 19:00 PT if green. Ping here for blockers. :rocket:
